scope.capture: MD3 actual attachments capture the full two-appearance scene, not only the named field. Apple/shadcn failure screenshots capture the visible viewport. Secondary probe images show no actual component.

identityPolicy: Bind this completed run's captured worker snapshot and actual component assets. Parent is preparing a later flex-alignment fix; current host may differ. Old image conclusions do not approve that future proposal.

observations.md3: 24 actual attachments across 12 passed MD3 cases were all individually viewed. Values, superscript 3, outlined notch / filled in-field labels and help are visible, with muted lock steppers. Disabled dark images are deliberately dim; no contrast ratio or focus claim is made from a single PNG.
observations.appleShadcn: All 24 actual UI failure screenshots were individually viewed. The exponent 3 remains discernible; no new clear collision between fields, labels, help or steppers was established. This does not satisfy the failed strict Range contract, and these images do not establish positioned glyph ink clipping.
observations.blank: All 23 separate pure-white 1280x720 images were individually viewed, including repeated SHA. They are secondary probe diagnostics, not component white-screen or appearance evidence.
observations.focusAndLocks: This batch targets scientific read-only / disabled locks; measured input focused=false. Native values/flags/trusted wheel records and full passed-case assertions are separate from visual observation; there is no keyboard focus-ring matrix here.

failure.stageBoundary: All 24 Apple/shadcn cases stop during outlined Range geometry. Filled controls are visible in their UI screenshots, but no filled locked-content / geometry attachments completed for those cases. Only the 12 MD3 cases measured and reached both appearance captures.
failure.inkBoundary: DOM Range rectangles are browser text layout boxes, not glyph ink bounds. Detached Canvas font/ink metrics are diagnostic and cannot position actual glyph ink in the clipped overlay. No claim that ink clipping was proved; no assertion threshold was relaxed.
failure.futureCandidate: A new flex-alignment source/build/capture is required and must be independently reviewed; none was captured or approved here.
